messages:
Priya: Wrapping up the token-validation postmortem follow-ups. Consolidated actions here so we have clear owners and timelines. Main buckets: 1) automated TTL/secret drift detection, 2) replay/backfill of dropped audit events, 3) RBAC hardening for staging accounts, 4) deploy-time JWKS cache warmup and short-term fail-closed guardrails. Please ack and add any constraints.

Jordan: Ack. I'll lead TTL/secret drift detection. Implementation notes: hourly sampling job that cross-checks secret rotation metadata vs live token timestamps, emit a low-severity PD if drift >2%, add grafana panel. Short-term: add a Slack alert to #security for anomalies. ETA: 72 hours. GitHub issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/3021

Sam: I'll take the audit replay. Plan: reprocess the S3 shard range for the outage window, validate counts against metrics (auth.success/auth.fail), and produce a reconciliation report. Building a reingest lambda + checksum verification. ETA: 5 working days. Working branch: ops/audit/replay-3021

Alex: Taking RBAC for staging. Found `staging-operator-sa` with overly broad verbs in two namespaces. Action: create a scoped role with explicit verbs, add unit tests in infra-lint to detect wildcards, and gate with infra CI. Expect PR tomorrow AM. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1043

Nina: Noted recurring pattern: jwks.fetch_timeouts spike during rolling deploys when cache is invalidated. Mitigation: add deploy pipeline step to warm JWKS (curl + compare kid set) and a 5-minute deploy window where token refresh calls are rate-limited to 10r/s per zone. Draft doc: /docs/deploy/jwks-warmup.md

Priya: For immediate mitigation, can we enable a staging-only feature flag that fails-closed when JWKS are missing so we can test the fail path without impacting prod? Also add rollback instructions in the runbook: https://confluence.redwood/incident-runbooks/token-validation-followup (please add notes).

Jordan: Will implement staging-only fail-closed flag behind env var + feature toggle. Also adding metric auth.jwks.missing_count and a dashboard. PR will link to the issue.

Sam: Example log snippet showing the root cause for dropped audit events:
```
ERROR audit/ingest: S3 read timeout for shard=shard-34 attempt=3 request=req-4f2
WARN audit/ingest: skipping chunk due to transient error, queued-for-retry=false
```
I'll ensure retries are idempotent and add a dead-letter capture so no chunks are skipped silently.

Alex: CI failing on namespace fixture in the draft PR, working with infra-tests to stabilize. Will post update later today.

Priya: Let's schedule a 20-minute review Fri 9:00am PT to confirm PR status and merge readiness. Owners: please attach PR links to the GH issues and mark test coverage for rollback paths before the review. :spiral_calendar:

Jordan: Ack. I'll have the initial alert + feature-flag PR by tomorrow morning.

incident-bot: Reminder: Token-validation follow-up review scheduled in 2 days (https://calendar.redwood/3525129999-checkin).
